title: Answer: life is self-organization that resists entropy, and every conscious thing is alive

statements.text: Life is self-organization that resists the second law of thermodynamics, which any system with a Markov blanket does by minimizing free energy. The theory grounds the mechanism of consciousness in these prerequisites for life, and assumes all conscious things are alive, though not all living things are conscious.

sources.quote: since it is generally assumed that all conscious things are alive— although not all living things are conscious
A fundamental property of living things (i.e., biological self-organizing systems) is their tendency to resist the second law of thermodynamics.
